module_title: Composition and Structure of NITI Aayog
introduction: NITI Aayog has a complex, multi-layered administrative structure designed to include experts, state leaders, and central ministers. At this level, we memorize who holds which position.

core_concepts.title: Chairperson
core_concepts.description: The 'Prime Minister of India' serves as the Ex-officio Chairperson of NITI Aayog (Currently: Narendra Modi).

core_concepts.title: Vice-Chairperson and CEO
core_concepts.description:
1. Vice-Chairperson: Appointed by the Prime Minister. Holds the rank of a Cabinet Minister. 
2. Chief Executive Officer (CEO): Appointed by the PM for a fixed tenure. Holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.

core_concepts.title: Governing Council
core_concepts.description: This is the ultimate decision-making body within NITI Aayog (replacing the old National Development Council). It comprises the PM, 'Chief Ministers of all States and Union Territories with Legislatures', and Lt. Governors of other UTs.

core_concepts.title: Regional Councils
core_concepts.description: These are created 'temporarily' to address specific issues impacting more than one state or a specific region (e.g., a drought affecting South India). They are convened by the PM and comprise the CMs and Lt. Governors of the region.

core_concepts.title: Members
core_concepts.description:
1. Full-Time Members: Enjoy the rank of a Minister of State. 
2. Ex-officio Members: Maximum of 4 members of the Union Council of Ministers, nominated by the PM. 
3. Special Invitees: Domain experts and specialists nominated by the PM.

important_entities.name: First Officials of NITI Aayog
important_entities.significance: First Chairperson: Narendra Modi. First Vice-Chairperson: Arvind Panagariya. First CEO: Sindhushree Khullar.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Students often assume that high-ranking officials like the Vice-Chairperson or CEO of NITI Aayog are appointed by the President of India. FALSE. They are appointed directly by the 'Prime Minister'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Governing = All India (Permanent), Regional = Local Issue (Temporary)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The Governing Council involves the whole country permanently. Regional Councils are formed only when needed for specific zones.

exam_strategy_tips: Knowing that the Governing Council includes 'ALL Chief Ministers' is crucial to understanding how NITI Aayog implements 'Cooperative Federalism'.
